visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. Built from components/site/v3. No mockup in this directory: the place-type class is the city/community type-card landing, not a Tetherow one-off.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Coldwell Banker type-filtered city results. Those surfaces dump the visitor into a search grid. This page is a place-type node: leftover count and median that already back the type card, a living atlas of the parent city with the type stated in the claim, and a photographed list of that type. Unique title, canonical, ItemList when listings exist. Breadcrumb is City then type, no Home.
note: H1 is `{Type} in {Place}` and it is the page's only display-scale line: the Atlas opens under the claim wearing an eyebrow (V3Atlas headlineTone='eyebrow', subject softened to Listings). One section-0 sourced claim sentence sits under the H1 — count and ~p90 price band from ONE listing_tile_mv read, worded as the address census with the map marking for-sale homes inside city limits (pending key hidden on this page). A V3Carousel mode=rail of photographed listings (PlaceTypeFilm; shadcn-carousel adapted with side prev/next) follows Atlas in the fold with price+address+beds/baths/sqft on 800x600 plates. The Atlas section is UNCONDITIONAL via PlaceTypeAtlasSection + PlaceTypeAtlasStandin. Rows and marks share one hovered key. Unknown type notFound(). Do not collide with app/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug].

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts place-type --builder claude-opus-5.5 --shots <the 4 files below>. The grok CLI and the Cursor CLI are missing in this sandbox, so the judge chain fell to its claude link (claude CLI, sonnet, subscription): three scorings of these shots in one call, recorded exactly as returned, no re-roll. Builder claude-opus-5.5 is not the judge.

shotSpec.capture: node scripts/take-route-shots.mjs place-type http://127.0.0.1:3484/cities/bend/types/single-family --states 'dial-open=.place-type-film .v3-dial__step--next@.place-type-film!click'. First viewport, scale 1, palette-quantized, against this branch's own next build + next start.

tasteReview.beats: Zillow's Bend, OR home-price page: this page wins on sourcing (named MLS + Oregon Data Share + a stamped pull time) and on tying median price directly to subdivision shape on the map instead of a generic price-heat overlay, but Zillow's grid still moves faster to compare many homes at once than this single-frame listing dial does.

defects.finding: one marker reads bare '$479k' with no 'median' prefix while all 17 others say 'median $XXXk' — the labeling pattern breaks on its own map, which reads as a data error rather than a design choice

defects.section: price range slider ('Up to any price')
defects.finding: the track is filled solid to the far right end with no tick marks, min/max labels, or a visible price at the handle, so at rest it looks like a maxed-out progress bar rather than an interactive filter — nothing in the static frame promises a draggable range

the dial is showing 2244 Lolo Drive in NorthWest Crossing but the map behind it shows no ring, pin, or highlighted parcel for that home — the two data surfaces sit next to each other without visibly linking, so the map reads as decoration rather than as tracking the photo you're on

'Single-family in Bend' plus 'Nine in ten ask between $379,500 and $2,149,000' is correct and well-sourced but reads exactly like a template would generate for any city/type pair — nothing here is specific enough to Bend that you'd screenshot it

tasteReview.verdict: This is a competent, honestly-sourced page, not a breathtaking one: the median-price map and the numbered listing dial are real, deliberate choices that beat a plain Zillow list, but the slider looks broken at rest, one map label breaks its own pattern, and the map never visibly tracks the home the dial is showing. demoMatch is false because nothing on this page is a catalog component standing in for a house form — it's house-atlas, house-quiet, and house-listing-dial doing their jobs adequately but without the polish or the linkage that would make a visitor stop scrolling.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel grok-4.6 -> claude-sonnet-5; shotsHash (new captures of the listing dial, Matt 2026-09-24, SITE-195). The judge is a different instrument from the prior mark, so this is the first mark on the claude-sonnet-5 ruler for this class and the floor the next pass may not fall under.
